intro_md: 📖 **8 min.** A different kind of reading: the **noticeboard** in Jess's café. Six short notices – read once, fast, and find the facts.

parts.title: The café noticeboard
parts.md:
**Four useful phrases for notices** (read them first – then look for them in the text):

| Phrase | 🖼️ Picture it (literal) | So it means… |
|---|---|---|
| *for sale* | a price label hanging on a bike in a shop window | someone wants to sell it |
| *in good condition* | a shiny old chair with no cracks and no marks | not broken, still works well |
| *get in touch* | your hand reaches out and touches someone's arm | contact the person (call or write) |
| *must go* | a big box in a small room, and a sign: "Out by Friday" | has to be taken away soon |

💡 *Examples:* The old piano is **for sale**. · My watch is **in good condition**. · Please **get in touch** if you have questions. · These boxes **must go** today.

📖 **Read once, fast, without going back.** You don't need every word – just find the facts.

![The café noticeboard](data/img/w1/d14-noticeboard.webp)

> **1. BIKE FOR SALE**
>
> Blue city bike, three years old, in good condition. New lights and a basket. I'm moving house, so I need to sell it soon. £60. Please ask for Dave and leave your phone number at the counter.
>
> **2. LOST CAT**
>
> Our grey cat, Smokey, has been missing since Tuesday. He is very friendly and has a small white spot on his nose. If you see him near Hope Street or the park, please get in touch with the café. There is a reward!
>
> **3. TALK TO ME – CONVERSATION CLUB**
>
> Do you speak Spanish and want to practise English? Or the other way round? Come and chat with us every Thursday at 7 pm in the back room of the café. It's free, and there is tea and cake. Everyone is welcome.
>
> **4. ROOM TO RENT**
>
> A small, sunny room in a shared house, five minutes from the tram stop. Two other people live there, and they are quiet and tidy. £450 a month, and the bills are included. Please come and see it on Saturday afternoon.
>
> **5. YOGA IN THE CHURCH HALL**
>
> Gentle yoga for beginners every Monday at 6.30 pm. Bring a towel or your own mat. The first class is free, so just try it. No need to book, but please arrive ten minutes early.
>
> **6. FREE SOFA – MUST GO BY SUNDAY**
>
> A big green sofa, very comfortable, with a few small marks. It is too big for our new flat, so it must go by Sunday. You have to carry it yourself. Please call Priya if you want it.

parts.title: Quick check + how was it?
parts.md: A few quick questions – tap an answer, you see right away if it's right. Then tell me how much you understood, ask me anything below, and 📤 **Submit**.

questions.q: How much is the blue bike?
Why must the sofa go by Sunday?
options: It is too big for the new flat

check.answer: It is too big for the new flat
check.why: Notice 6: *It is too big for our new flat, so it must go by Sunday.* Here **it** = the sofa.

questions.q: How much did you understand? Write a number, e.g. 80
